**Image Prompt 1:**

A chaotic, high-energy collage in the "Hachi Broadcast & Godínez Survival" style. The central figure is Hachi, a maltese-chihuahua mix with oversized, neotenous eyes and a perpetually lolling tongue, rendered as a PNG sticker with a thick white outline. Hachi is surrounded by a dense overlay of WhatsApp and Discord stickers, including green WhatsApp chat bubbles and blue Discord notification badges. Visible fragments of HTML and CSS code are interspersed, along with pixelated icons representing public transport and office supplies. A "stress thermometer" graphic is prominently displayed in a corner, indicating a high level. The background is a vibrant, flat gradient of WhatsAppGreen and MemePink. The overall mood is internet-infused, juvenile, and catartic.

A dynamic, asymmetrical editorial grid composition in the "Hachi Broadcast & Godínez Survival" style.
